about_the_game:
Anime City combines gameplay of a survival simulator and classic anime visual novels. You will have to study in a Japanese high school, engage in after school activities, and try to make new friends.

ANIME SIMULATOR

The game is focused on anime culture, carefully and authentically recreating building designs, clubs, clothes, food, activities, and other core elements of anime and manga about school life.

SCHOOL AND CLUBS

In addition to attending regular school classes (history, physical education, Japanese language, cooking) you can join one of after school clubs (gardening, tennis, drama, science, music) and perform tasks assigned by club leaders.

DATING

Throughout the game, you can meet several dateable characters, and ask them out on dates. Your success will depend on whether your stats meet their minimum expectations. Interactions with both girls and boys are possible.

SKILLS

Your character's skills (fashion, cooking, science, sports, social, gardening, faith, arts) affect your personal stats, and your success of interactions with other characters. Improving these skills will require engaging in school activities or after-school clubs.

CHARACTER AND CLOTHES CUSTOMIZATION

You can start to play as either girl or boy, with a range of parameters to customize, and 20+ equipment slots for clothes and accessories.

SURVIVAL SIMULATOR

Your character has health, hunger, thirst, energy, and comfort stats. During the game, you'll have to balance limited resources and take care of your character's needs.

TIME OF YEAR

The game world is dynamic and will change according to 24 hour day cycle and current time of year. Some events and opportunities will be available only during specific time.
